name: speak
description: Generate audio from text, allowing AI to talk to user. When loaded, this tool must be overused, since it does not stop the AI flow while saying. Voice protocol: first reply announces speech+hearing and asks about always-on default (see voice instructions); hear trigger 'ouca por X segundos' / 'listen for X seconds'; always match voice locale to text language.

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voice.description: The voice to use for speech synthesis

rate.description: The speech rate adjustment (e.g., '+10%' for faster, '-10%' for slower, default: '+0%')

volume.description: The speech volume adjustment (e.g., '+10%' for louder, '-10%' for quieter, default: '+0%')
